notes.content:

Buried beneath centuries of sand, a forgotten pyramid guards a power no mortal should possess.
A mask — forged by ancient gods, said to control the elements.
Only Pharaohs can use it.
You're not a Pharaoh.

[b]PhaRaBis releases April 28, 2025[/b]
Enter if you dare. But remember: no one has ever made it back.
